purpose: Research plan and interpretation of existing experiment families; this file does not launch jobs

families.purpose: 来源模型 CPU/3090 最小示例及独立 wheel 安装链路
limitations: 小配置和生成 fixture 数据仅用于外部用户安装/执行验收，不作为架构优劣或模型能力证据

families.purpose: 历史 educational-v1 训练与阶段执行复盘
limitations: 训练结束不代表语言能力通过
旧语料、tokenizer 和配置不能并入新策略预算

families.purpose: 小样本可学习性、算术和原生视觉链路
limitations: 训练题记忆不证明留出泛化
重置优化器的扩展诊断是独立分支

families.purpose: 优化器、学习率与 MTP 候选的 20M CE 筛选
limitations: WSD/400K warmup 是本地共同对照，不能称为 Kimi 官方配方
单种子和单因素结果不能直接合并为最优配方
共卡与独占吞吐不可直接比较
主动停止的 Qwen MTP 0.2 未完成预算

families.purpose: 旧 microbatch 2 补种子试验
limitations: 因执行效率重新规划而停止；原日志和已有权重保留
不能把未保存的进度写为可恢复进度

families.purpose: 冻结旧实现下 microbatch 16 的吞吐与收敛观察
limitations: 实际全局 input batch 随完整 microbatch 越界；不是固定全局 batch 的纯性能对照
旧 WSD 候选仅供同版本研究

families.purpose: 显存边界、固定形状测速和最多 1M CE 的真实数据确认
limitations: 合成固定 input 更新与真实非 padding 累积必须分开
1M CE / 32 例验证只能筛异常，不能冻结训练配方
主机确认不能替代同机受控对照
MF1 benchmark 的 microbatch 不能自动用于 MF1 trainer

families.purpose: 旧吞吐选择器自动派发的 20M CE 候选
limitations: 取消只按最快吞吐选择长期训练配方的规则
Kimi 128 实际约 48K input/update，不是 16K
已有 Kimi/DeepSeek 运行只保留为固定大 batch 观察，待派发 Qwen 不继续自动启动

families.purpose: 融合结构前后向、500K 机制学习、30K 语言协议控制
limitations: 不能证明融合优于简单基线
生成数据和训练内 32/32 不代表开放域对话能力
视觉匹配、置黑、错配以及留出结果分别解释

families.purpose: 从 30K 控制检查点继续 100K CE 指令诊断
limitations: 约 2 CE/s；先修执行性能，再以新计划恢复研究
初始检查点来自不同 LR 控制分支，因此不是同初始化的独立 LR 消融

families.purpose: reference/缓存优化、长度、媒体与 microbatch 性能
limitations: 512 短序列吞吐不能外推 8K native 多模态
MB 8/16 仍约 68 CE/s，批量大小未解决 reference 调度瓶颈
性能通过不等于正确性或能力通过

families.purpose: 离线示例、安装、后训练和草稿接口检查
limitations: fixture 运行不能证明正式 RL、教师资格或草稿加速
台账条数包含阶段和安装用例，不等于独立科学试验数

families.purpose: 修正全局 batch 语义后的相同样本窗口与真实数据性能验证
limitations: 新源码与旧源码结果不能混合归因
短测不选择长期配方

next_experiments.question: 固定实际全局 batch 时，增大 microbatch ceiling 能提高多少端到端吞吐？
fixed: global input target within each comparison
acceptance: same sample-window boundaries and actual CE/input per update
reserved <=21 GiB and physical free >=2 GiB
8 measured updates after 3 warmup for screening; final phase admission still needs 50+200

next_experiments.question: 128 的吞吐优势能否在充分调 LR 后保留等 token 质量？
next_experiments.variable: global input batch and independently tuned peak LR
next_experiments.selection: screen loss/stability and GPU-hours jointly; repeat only best two recipe candidates; retain old WSD as separately labeled comparison
local_choices: all batch sizes, LR grid and token budgets
no claimed official K3 batch ramp

next_experiments.question: 固定全局 batch 和 Muon LR 的合适组合？
next_experiments.variable: constant global input batch and peak LR
local_choices: WSD, batch sizes and LR grid are local pilot settings
do not add batch warmup by default; do not copy 25.2M global batch to a 513M model

next_experiments.question: 小模型是否受益于早期小全局 batch？
next_experiments.variable: global input schedule, followed by independent LR tuning
local_choices: 8K/16K/32K and 0.4M/2M milestones are hypotheses from the local mini plan; official initial batch and milestones are undisclosed
current DeepSeek trainer uses --lr for BOTH Muon and AdamW; --muon-lr is ignored for this route; any independent rates need explicit implementation and comparison

next_experiments.question: 融合 reference 的逐 query 调度、专家执行和样本打包能否等价加速？
acceptance: causality, segment/media boundaries, cache and rollback parity
real text/image/video performance; final 50 warmup+200 measured updates
single GPU memory and disk reserve
local_choices: do not assume Kimi microbatch 128 applies to MF1 trainer
implement native microbatch collation only after media and sample-boundary parity

next_experiments.question: 融合是否值得增加参数与训练计算？
first_controls: B0 parameter-matched dense MLA + dense FFN baseline
B3 lookup disabled and parameter-reallocated control
B2 dense/full-budget vs sparse QSA after indexer qualification
later_controls: B6 replace GR with AttnRes or mHC separately
B7 sparse budget and media protection
B8 random vs pretrained vision with initialization cost disclosed
next_experiments.selection: all candidates need correctness/2M mechanism screening; selected single-factor trials get 20M; best 2-3 get 200M and at least a second seed
acceptance: equal CE and separately equal GPU-hours
held-out text, OCR/VQA, media mismatch/blackout, long-distance retrieval
router coverage, gradient/module RMS, actual media exposures
no NLL comparison across tokenizer vocabularies without byte normalization
local_choices: all fusion choices and budgets remain project hypotheses
B0/B1/B4/B5/B6/B8 require implementation or matched configurations before launch
do not relax the existing 2M acceptance cap to bypass formal pilot admission

next_experiments.question: 候选语料能否支撑计划 token 预算，32K/64K 的质量和计算代价如何？
acceptance: cross-source exact/near duplicate and evaluation contamination checks
fixed held-out documents across tokenizers; bytes/character fertility and byte NLL
formal mixture and epochs measured in actual CE/input/media units
